slides.body: Appraisals, FHA financing and what buyers want in a floor plan. Tap through.

slides.label: APPRAISALS
slides.hero_caption: pages in some new appraisal reports
slides.headline: Appraisals are getting a lot more detailed.
slides.body: More property data means more room for delays. Ask your lender if their appraiser is ready for the new format, and set financing deadlines you can actually hit.

slides.label: FINANCING
slides.headline: HUD wants more Floridians owning homes.
slides.body: New scoring options could help some renters with thin credit files qualify for an FHA loan. More building, over time, means more choices for budget buyers.

slides.label: BUYER TRENDS
slides.hero_caption: home offices — what buyers are asking for now
slides.headline: One home office isn't enough anymore.
slides.body: New-construction buyers want flex space for work, hobbies and kids. If you're selling, show how a bonus room can do more than one job.
